headline: Amit Shah ka kadak sandesh: Naxalvad khatam: Modi sarkar ka sankalp poora hua, ab peedhiton ke zakhm par marham. Aap sehmat ho?
caption:
Amit Shah Naxal mukt Bharat Modi sarkar sankalp poora Bastar Divyang seva 🇮🇳
Amit Shah ne kaha ki Modi sarkar ka Naxalmukt Bharat banane ka sankalp poora hua. Ab Naxal hinsa se ghayal logon ke zakhmon par marham lagana hai.
Jagdalpur camp mein 3,600 se zyada divyangjano ko sahayak upkaran mile, jinme 1,570 se zyada akele Bastar se the.
Paanch dashkon tak Naxalvad ka dard jhela, ab har pidit ke samman se jeevan jeene ki vyavastha karni hai.
